# lokalise Provider

Manages [Lokalise](https://lokalise.com) setup: projects, project languages, and team user groups (role, languages, members, project assignments). It is non-authoritative: no resource removes anything it did not create. Projects and languages have `deletion_protection`, on by default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lokalise = {
      source = "petebeegle/lokalise"
    }
  }
}

# Reads the API token from the LOKALISE_API_TOKEN environment variable.
provider "lokalise" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) Lokalise API base URL. Defaults to https://api.lokalise.com/api2.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Lokalise API token. May also be set via the LOKALISE_API_TOKEN environment variable.
